If Activation Mode 4 becomes active the counter shall be reset to 0.
The counter shall increment for each engine operating hour during which the event is detected and the Continuous-MI is commanded to be on.
The counter shall halt its value when the Continuous-MI is no longer commanded to be on.
The counter shall continue its incrementation if the Continuous-MI is again commanded on within three operation sequences.
The counter shall reset to zero and start incrementing its value if the Continuous-MI is again commanded on after more than three operation sequences.
The counter shall reset to zero if the Continuous-MI is not commanded on after more than 40 warm-up cycles or after more than 200 engine operating hours or upon a ClearDTC request.
The counter shall be reported as a two byte value. If any count operation occurs which would cause a counter to roll over past 0x00FF then the count value shall instead be maintained at 0x00FF.
The counter shall be stored non-volatile.
The counter shall increment for each engine operating hour during which the event is detected and the Continuous-MI is commanded to be on,
The counter shall halt its value when the Continuous-MI is no longer commanded to be on,
The counter shall never be reset.
The counter shall be reported as a two byte value. If any count operation occurs which would cause a counter to roll over past 0x00FF then the count value shall instead be maintained at 0x00FF.
The counter shall be stored non-volatile.
The B1 counter shall increment for each 1 hour engine operating hour during which at least one Class B1 event is detected as Confirmed and TestFailed.
The B1 counter shall latch its value when no Class B1 event is no longer detected as Confirmed and TestFailed or after a ClearDTC request.
The B1 counter shall reset to zero after three consecutive operating sequences where no Class B1 event have been detected.
If B1 Counter exceeds 200 engine operating hours and no Class B1 event have been detected the counter shall be set to 190.
The B1 counter shall be reported as a two byte value. If any count operation occurs which would cause a counter to roll over past 0x00FF then the count value shall instead be latched at 0x00FF.
The B1 counter shall be stored non-volatile.
If the B1 counter exceeds 200 engine operating hours the Activation Mode 4 shall be active.
If at least one Class A event is Confirmed and TestFailed the Activation Mode 4 shall be active.
If Activation Mode 4 is active and no Activation Mode 4 relevant condition is present anymore, then the Activation Mode 3 shall be activated.

If Activation Mode 4 has been degraded to Activation Mode 3 and an Activation Mode 4 relevant event is confirmed the Activation Mode 4 shall be reactivated if the configured value of EventFailureCycleCounterThreshold is reached.
If Activation Mode 3 is active and no Activation Mode 3 and Activation Mode 4 relevant condition is present, then the Activation Mode 1 shall be set.
If an Class C event is Confirmed and TestFailed and no Activation Mode 3 or Activation Mode 4 is active, the Activation Mode 2 shall be set to active.

Functionality of Dem_GetDTCSuppression If Dem_GetDTCSuppression is called, the Dem shall return the DTC suppression status in the output parameter SuppressionStatus . A value of TRUE means that the DTC was suppressed by a call of Dem_SetDTCSuppression with SuppressionStatus = TRUE, a value of FALSE means, that the DTC is currently not suppressed.

Continous trigger conditions for freeze frames If the DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_TRIGGER_ON_EVERY_TEST_FAILED , each time an event was reported as FAILED or after optional debouncing a qualified FAILED is detected the Dem shall capture the Freeze frame .

If at least one storage condition assigned to an event is not fulfilled, the Dem shall skip the calculation to set the bits: • bit 2 (PendingDTC) and • bit 3 (ConfirmedDTC). in the corresponding event status byte and UDS status byte from 0 to 1.

If the configuration parameter DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_J1939LAMP_STATUS , then the lamp status in the format of type Dem_J1939DcmLampStatusType shall be mapped to the respective data element.
The DemInternalDataElement for DEM_J1939LAMP_STATUS shall contain the lamp status before the event was processed Dem internally.
Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords shall retrieve the number of freeze frame records in primary memory that match the current filter.

API behavior without set DTC filter If any of the APIs requiring a Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter is called without a prior call of Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter for this client, the Dem shall report the Det DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION.

Usage of monitorData1 in internal data If DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_MONITOR_DATA_1 , the Dem shall use the 32 bit value of the provided monitorData1 parameter value of the call Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData as internal data value.
If Dem_SetDTCSuppression is called the Dem shall set the suppression status of the selected DTC to value of the parameter SuppressionStatus .
Operation Cycle restart The Dem shall only restart operation cycles after the previous restart has been fully processed. In other words this means that there is no Operation Cycle restart queue.
The Dem shall store the qualification state of the dependent operation cycles over power cycles.

Operation Cycle restart Calling the function Dem_RestartOperationCycle shall be allowed only after Dem_PreInit . In case an operation cycle is restarted before Dem_Init , the processing of the restart shall be done after Dem_Init .
Non volatile storage of pre-stored data If DemFFPrestorageInNvm is set to TRUE, the Dem shall store pre-stored freeze-frame data for this event on in Nvm.

Point in time to store pre-stored data in non-volatile memory If the Dem is configured to store pre-stored freezeframe data in non-volatile memory according to [SWS_Dem_01320], the Dem shall store the data once and latest during Dem_Shutdown .

Point in time to retrieve pre-stored data from non-volatile memory If the Dem is configured to store pre-stored freezeframe data in non-volatile memory according to [SWS_Dem_01320], the Dem shall restore the pre-stored data before Dem_Init has returned.

Consistency of non-volatile stored pre-stored data If the Dem is restoring pre-stored data according to [SWS_Dem_01322], the Dem shall only restore this data if it is consistent to the current configuration. If after reprogramming or calibration, the data layout has changed, the Dem shall skip the pre-stored data.
During Dem_Init the Dem initializes the monitor and component states. After this point in time, the Dem shall return E_OK on the APIs Dem_GetMonitorStatus and Dem_GetComponentFailed .
The Dem shall call FiM_DemInit after the monitor and component states have been initialized.

Monitor status initialization The Dem shall initialize the monitor status in the following way: • If Dem_SetEventStatus is called between Dem_PreInit and Dem_Init , the reported monitor status shall be used. • If no monitor status was reported before Dem_Init , the Dem shall use the event status recovered from NvM as the monitor status.

Capturing event related data with monitor data If the ReadData operation is configured to provide the monitorData0 , the Dem shall add the monitorData0 from the Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData to the ReadData operation parameter monitorData0 .
Handling of missing monitorData If the data capturing was triggered from within an API call without monitorData, the Dem shall use a value of 0 as monitorData.

In case an event is partially cleared according to [SWS_Dem_00669], the dependent functionality shall be handled as if the event is not cleared at all. This means the callback function InitMonitorForEvent will not be called and the FDC will remain unchanged in this situation.

The API Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData shall have the same functionality as Dem_SetEventStatus with the only difference that it provides further parameters with data to store in an event related data.

Usage of monitorData0 in internal data If DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_MONITOR_DATA_0 , the Dem shall use the 32 bit value of the provided monitorData0 parameter value of the call Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData as internal data value.

Setting DTR results for unavailable events If Dem_SetDTR is called for an DTR that references via DemDtrEventRef an event that itself is configured with DemEventAvailable to FALSE, the Dem shall return E_NOT_OK and not compute the DTR .

Reporting DTRs for unavailable events If Dem_DcmGetDTRData is called for an DTR that references via DemDtrEventRef an event that itself is configured with DemEventAvailable to FALSE, the Dem shall return E_NOT_OK. In this case all the out-parameters of Dem_DcmGetDTRData are undefined.
The Dem shall support the predefined DTC group GroupOfAllDTCs (0xFFFFFF) within the parameter DTC of Dem_SelectDTC .
The Dem shall support the predefined DTC group emission related DTCs for WWH-OBD and J1979-2 (0xFFFF33) within the parameter DTC of Dem_SelectDTC if WWH-OBD or J1979-2 is supported.

Enable/disable Events by configuration The configuration parameter DemEventAvailableInVariant shall be used as master to consider an Event as enabled or disabled. Dealing with availability of Events The Dem shall treat an event as unavailable if: • DemEventAvailableInVariant == FALSE or • DemEventAvailable == FALSE or • DemEventAvailable is overwritten by Dem_SetEventAvailable (FALSE) or • The component referenced by DemComponentClassRef is not available

Select freeze frame data for single DTCs only In case the function Dem_SelectFreezeFrameData is called and the DTC selected by Dem_SelectDTC is not a single DTC but a group of DTC, the Dem shall return DEM_WRONG_DTC .

Select extended data record for single DTCs only In case the function Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord is called and the DTC selected by Dem_SelectDTC is not a single DTC but a group of DTC, the Dem shall return DEM_WRONG_DTC .

Mapping of static event associated identifier to internal data elements If the DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFICATION , the Dem shall use the static configured value in DemEventAssociatedIdentification as value for this internal data element.
If the DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_TRIGGER_ON_TEST_FAILED_THIS_OPERATION_CYCLE , the FreezeFrame shall be captured each time the UDS status bit 1 (TFTOC) has a transition from 0 to 1.

Setting event failed with synchronous freeze frame processing If Dem_SetEventFailedWithSyncFreezeFrame is called, the Dem shall process the event status in the same way a call of Dem_SetEventStatus with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED .
Synchronous snapshot record processing If Dem_SetEventFailedWithSyncFreezeFrame is called, the Dem shall capture the UDS snapshot record data synchronous within the call of this function.
